candidateDeltaAudit.interfaceContract: NO BLOCKING CHANGE. All twelve flags the harness projects still parse into the same options (--no-base-instructions, --workspace, --workspace-backend, --workspace-authorization, --process-isolation, --process-close-policy, --command-policy, --workspace-grant, --tool-exclude, --attempt-evidence, --max-model-cycles, --model); none was renamed, removed, defaulted differently or made newly required. The attempt-evidence JSONL keeps its header/model-request/model-outcome/model-failure shape and its reason vocabulary (connection, transport, timeout, malformed, input-over-window). Provider materialization (BEST_AGENT_PROVIDER_CONFIG keys model/reasoningEffort/timeoutMs, DIMCODE_HOME, BEST_AGENT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL, BEST_AGENT_STORAGE_ROOT) is unchanged, headless exit is still 0/1, interaction is still off by default, and no TUI or confirmation prompt was added.
candidateDeltaAudit.modelVisibleChanges: MATERIAL, and the reason this arm is not a like-for-like repeat. A new `shell` tool (best-agent/builtin-tools/workspace-shell-v1) joins the headless tool list whenever --command-policy path resolves $SHELL (always in this composition), executed as <shell> -c through the plain backend under the existing workspace-exec approval profile; exec's description was rewritten to route pipelines, redirections and globs to shell; the workspace routing instruction appends the shell/exec sentence; the process-routing instruction now states both routing policies, including a sandbox clause that does not apply to this plain backend; eight structured-file tools plus apply_patch reworded the absolute-path sentence to 'absolute paths require the current execution policy or an explicit external-path grant'; and the environment block prints Shell as a basename instead of an absolute path. No tool was removed or renamed. The TUI-only additions in the range (tui-settings, BTW side questions, steering, worktrees defaulting off) have no caller in a headless run.
candidateDeltaAudit.frozenQuantities: No change to DEFAULT_MODEL_TIMEOUT_MS (900,000), MAX_PROCESS_LIFETIME_MS, MAX_PARALLEL_TOOL_CALLS_PER_MODEL_CYCLE, SERVER_MAX_MODEL_CYCLES, COMPACT_ROUND_BOUND_MS or the per-cycle attempt budget. The per-call ceiling this run materializes is still the frozen 1,800,000 ms and every cell keeps its own official budget.

constraints: One predeclared attempt per cell over the exact frozen corpus; no second attempt in this manifest.
No verdict, frozen record, repair or artifact of 40326110478, 40257143514, 39883822819 or any earlier run is replaced, repaired or reinterpreted by this run.
Nothing here is read as a model-capability result: with public egress and no contamination gate, a model failure cannot be separated from an answer source a cell may have reached.
Every error cell keeps its mechanical cause in the record; an error is never counted as a model failure.
No budget, timeout or effort is extended to make any cell scoreable.
This run's pass@1 comes only from its own frozen aggregate report, and only if every predeclared cell carries a verdict.

knownRisks.firstBuildOfThisCommit: No published build of e4a8c4477 exists. The packaging path changed only on Windows and the local darwin build of this exact commit passed build, staging, installed-package smoke and PTY smoke, but a linux-x64-gnu build of this commit has never run. If it fails, fh-candidate fails closed before any model call and the run produces no verdicts; that is a pre-model build failure, not a benchmark result.
knownRisks.newShellTool: The shell tool is new to this benchmark's tool list. It shares the existing workspace-exec approval profile and needs only the grants this composition already provides, so it cannot block on interaction; it can, however, move a cell's command routing and therefore its budget consumption.
knownRisks.providerVariance: The previous recheck measured one flip and three repeats under the same provider conditions. A recurrence here is expected and is not evidence about the candidate.
knownRisks.noContaminationGate: Public egress and no gate: a cell that reaches its upstream solution is not detected here.
knownRisks.emptyPatchCaptureGap: The datacurve collect hook diffs base..HEAD, so a cell that edits without committing still grades the pristine tree. Not changed here.
knownRisks.rerun: One attempt per cell. A cell that fails keeps its canonical verdict; no retry is admitted by this manifest.
knownRisks.noReproducibleBinary: The SEA build is not byte-reproducible, so this run's binarySha256 is its own; the receipt and the per-run candidateId are the only identity that binds the attempts to the pinned commit.
knownRisks.smokeGate: No full run is dispatched until a single-task smoke has proven the new candidate builds on the runner, passes the delivery gate, materializes glm-5.3 at high and reaches the model phase with frozen evidence.
